detail.longDescription: I love gaming but now in my 30's, there's never enough time and when I have an hour, I have no idea what to play or what I'll actually finish so I watch Youtube or buy more games I'll never play. I built UpNext so I can focus on the games I own and enjoy them. It takes in all your game libraries, play history and favorites. Simply tell it your mood and how much time you have and it suggests games. Every game gets details like length, review scores, what it feels like to play, what players say, and tags pulled from Steam, PCGamingWiki, ProtonDB, etc. Local and remote AI supported but not required. Available on Windows, Linux, Docker, Steam Deck (flatpak), Android APK. Runs locally with no accounts. Built in Rust and TypeScript with Opus 5.5, MIT/Apache 2.0 License Do you think the picks are still good with no AI?
